## About
We're RB Construction General Contractor, located on Edinburgh St in San Francisco. Our mission is to deliver the best quality in every project we take on, while keeping it cost-effective for the community of San Francisco and its surrounding areas.
Rafael Barajas leads the team, and we use the best materials in the industry so the work lasts. Neighbors who've hired us rate us 4.9 from 39 Google reviews. One reviewer told us he was nervous after hearing horror stories about contractors, and that we were straight with him from day one.

## Services
- Bathroom Remodeling: Your bathroom should be a place to relax and unwind after a long day. We'll help you get there.
- Kitchen Remodeling: Kitchen projects of all sizes, styles and budgets.
- General Remodeling: Full home remodeling to turn your house into the space you've wanted.
- Painting Services: Painting to refresh the look of your home or commercial property.
- Drywall Installation: Drywall installation for residential and commercial properties.
- Roofing Services: Roofing work from a team that knows San Francisco homes.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Get in touch and we'll give you a free estimate for any of the services we offer.

Q: How can I pay?
A: We accept cash and checks.

Q: What areas do you work in?
A: San Francisco and its surrounding areas, including Pacific Heights, Sausalito, Oakland, Richmond, Pleasanton, San Jose, Santa Clara and Santa Cruz.

Q: Who will I be working with?
A: Rafael Barajas and his team. One reviewer called working with them a delightful experience.
